name: filter-row
title: Filter Row
description: The chips under a ListToolbar: + Filter, pinned facets (dashed while unset), the other chips, Clear — and after an AI filter run, one line with what it added, Undo and what it could not match.

meta.whenToUse: The filters a ListToolbar's Filter tool opens: facets, applied chips, the AI note.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single search box, or a condition builder (FilterBuilder in a dialog).
